score_parameters: Frozen on source patients per context
null_reference: Label-outcome residual Gram including measurement masks; only used to compute the label test, never as model input or to select models
method: Two-sided Fisher statistic calibrated using 100000 correlated-normal conditional-null draws; exact single-readout/perfect-dependence cases; Bonferroni only for unknown dependence
interpretation: Association evidence for a canonical biological target, not a patient activity scale or causal probability
